<!-- BEGIN USER:expert_evaluation -->











**Šo sadaļu aizpildām manuāli no ekspertu aptaujām**


The model was considered ecologically plausible overall. Although the main 
predictors showed relatively large uncertainty, no clearly uninterpretable 
response relationships were identified. The habitat-suitability map agreed very 
well with expert knowledge: known and field-tested locations were classified 
appropriately, and no obviously implausible suitability patterns were evident. 
Some small predicted hotspots occurred outside the currently known range, but 
these were considered reasonable because the model included all known occurrences 
while also identifying a plausible amount of potentially suitable habitat beyond 
the presently documented distribution. The map was considered suitable for 
species-conservation planning when used together with other ecological 
information, while the explanatory value of the marginal response functions 
was somewhat more limited.

Expert: Andris Čeirāns

### Version evolution {-}

<!-- BEGIN USER:version_evolution -->











**Šo sadaļu aizpildām manuāli, izmntojot sagatavotās shēmas. Jāvienojas par to noformējumu**



The following diagram describes version evolution during modelling. 
Colour codes:

- **black**: branch in version evolution from the initial EGV selection up 
until the best version;

- **green**: the final version;

- **grey**: other versions.

All the modifications on the black-to-green branch are described below the 
diagram.


```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width='100%'}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DiagrammeR))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DiagrammeRsvg))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(rsvg))


coraus_shema="digraph flowchart {
  rankdir = LR


  # node type pamatainavas
  node [fontname = Helvetica, shape = none,style=none,fontface=bold,fontsize=6,fontcolor=white];{
    node [label='Pamatainavas']; level0;
    node [label='Level 1']; level1;
    node [label='Level 2']; level2;
    node [label='Level 3']; level3;
    node [label='Level 4']; level4;
    node [label='Level 5']; level5;
    node [label='Level 6']; level6;
    node [label='Level 7']; level7;
  }


  # node type 0: grupas
  node [fontname = Helvetica, shape = rectangle,style=rounded,fontface=bold,fontsize=30,fontcolor=black];{
    node [label='CORAUS']; sp2;
  }

  # node type: versijas
  node [fontname = Helvetica, shape = rectangle,style=rounded,fontface=bold,fontsize=30,fontcolor=black];{
    node [label='v0']; v0b;
  node [label='v1']; v1b;
  node [label='v2b']; v2b2;
  node [label='v2b\n(with 2025)']; v2b2025;
  node [label='v2b\n(2014-2025)']; v2b2014;
  }
  
  # node type: jaunasversijas-i
  node [fontname = Helvetica, shape = rectangle,style=rounded,fontface=bold,fontsize=30,fontcolor=grey];{
  node [label='v2a']; v2a2;
  node [label='v2a\n(with 2025)']; v2a2025;
  node [label='v2a5\n(2014-2025)']; v2a2014_5;
  node [label='v2a\n(2014-2025)']; v2a2014;
  node [label='v2a1\n(2014-2025)']; v2a2014_1;
  }
  
  
  # node type: previousbest
  node [fontname = Helvetica, shape = rectangle,style=rounded,fontface=bold,fontsize=30,fontcolor=darkgreen];{
  node [label='v2b1\n(2014-2025)']; v2b2014_1;
  }

  
  # node type: jaunasversijas-ii
  node [fontname = Helvetica, shape = rectangle,style=rounded,fontface=bold,fontsize=30,fontcolor=grey];{
  node [label='v2b5\n(2014-2025)']; v2b2014_5;
  node [label='v3b5\n(2014-2025)']; v3b2014_5;
  node [label='v3b1\n(2014-2025)']; v3b2014_1;
  }
  
  

    # specify which nodes are of the same 'rank' so that they'll be drawn at the same level
      {rank = same; level0 sp2}
      {rank = same; level1 v0b}
      {rank = same; level2 v1b}
      {rank = same; level3 v2b2}
      {rank = same; level4 v2a2025 v2b2025}
      {rank = same; level5 v2a2014 v2b2014}
      {rank = same; level6 v2a2014_5 v2b2014_5 v2a2014_1 v2b2014_1}
      {rank = same; level7 v3b2014_5 v3b2014_1}

    edge[tailclip = true, headclip = true,color=white,arrowhead=none];
      level0 -> level1
      level1 -> level2
      level2 -> level3
      level3 -> level4
      level4 -> level5
      level5 -> level6
      level6 -> level7
      
    edge[tailclip = true, headclip = true,color=black,arrowhead=none];
      sp2 -> v0b
      v0b -> v1b
      v1b -> v2a2
      v1b -> v2b2
      v2a2 -> v2a2025
      v2b2 -> v2b2025
      v2a2025 -> v2a2014
      v2b2025 -> v2b2014
      v2a2014 -> v2a2014_5
      v2b2014 -> v2b2014_5
      v2a2014 -> v2a2014_1
      v2b2014 -> v2b2014_1
      v2b2014_1 -> v3b2014_1
      v2b2014_5 -> v3b2014_5

}"

species_code="CORAUS"
graph <- DiagrammeR::grViz(coraus_shema)

# Persistent output directory relative to book/
out_dir <- file.path("figures", "version_evolution")

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}

svg_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  paste0(species_code, "_version_evolution.svg")
)

pdf_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  paste0(species_code, "_version_evolution.pdf")
)

# Always regenerate the species-specific files
svg_txt <- DiagrammeRsvg::export_svg(graph)

writeLines(
  svg_txt,
  svg_file
)

rsvg::rsvg_pdf(
  svg_file,
  pdf_file
)

# Include the appropriate version
if (knitr::is_html_output()) {

  knitr::include_graphics(svg_file)

} else if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

  knitr::include_graphics(pdf_file)
}
```


**v0 to v1**

- EGVs excluded:

  - egv_150: (Edges_Roads_cell.tif) Edge pixels of Roads within the analysis cell (1 ha)
  
  - egv_423: (General_ForestsWithoutInventory_cell.tif) Fractional cover of Forests Without Inventory within the analysis cell (1 ha)
  
  - egv_424: (General_ForestsWithoutInventory_r500.tif) Fractional cover of Forests Without Inventory within the 0.5 km landscape
  
  - egv_425: (General_ForestsWithoutInventory_r1250.tif) Fractional cover of Forests Without Inventory within the 1.25 km landscape
  
  - egv_426: (General_ForestsWithoutInventory_r3000.tif) Fractional cover of Forests Without Inventory within the 3 km landscape
  
  - egv_427: (General_ForestsWithoutInventory_r10000.tif) Fractional cover of Forests Without Inventory within the 10 km landscape
  
  - egv_255: (FarmlandSubsidies_BiologicalSubsidies_cell.tif) Fractional cover of Farmland receiving Subsidies for Biological Agriculture within the analysis cell (1 ha)
  
  - egv_256: (FarmlandSubsidies_BiologicalSubsidies_r500.tif) Fractional cover of Farmland receiving Subsidies for Biological Agriculture within the 0.5 km landscape
  
  - egv_257: (FarmlandSubsidies_BiologicalSubsidies_r1250.tif) Fractional cover of Farmland receiving Subsidies for Biological Agriculture within the 1.25 km landscape
  
  - egv_258: (FarmlandSubsidies_BiologicalSubsidies_r3000.tif) Fractional cover of Farmland receiving Subsidies for Biological Agriculture within the 3 km landscape
  
  - egv_259: (FarmlandSubsidies_BiologicalSubsidies_r10000.tif) Fractional cover of Farmland receiving Subsidies for Biological Agriculture within the 10 km landscape


**v1 to v2b**

- EGVs excluded:

  - egv_093: (Distance_Sea_cell.tif) Distance to Sea, average within the analysis cell (1 ha)

  
- LULC change since the year of observation until the year 2024 are not used in 
observation filtering.


**v2b_cv to v2b2025_cv**

- occurence records from 2025 included in the presence data


**vb2025_cv to v2b2014_cv**

- occurence records from 2014-2015 included in the presence data


**v2b2014_cv to v2b1_2014_cv**

- variable permutation importance ensured at at least 1% if not affecting TSS

- ensuring bottom limitation of the bias layer at 10% of the layers global average
